text: 活到快四十岁才发现一个基本道理，在体制内工作，你的发展成就，99%取决于别人对你的认可和评价。
en: It was not until I was nearly forty that I came to realise a basic truth: working within the system, your professional advancement depends 99% on others' recognition of and assessment of you.

text: 那别人是怎么评估你的？
en: So how do others assess you?

text: 99%的语言+1%的行为。
en: 99% words and 1% conduct.

text: 绝大多数情况下，啥也没有的你，遇不到什么关键的行为选择，一般都是语言沟通。
en: In the vast majority of cases, you, with nothing much to your name, will not encounter any crucial choices of conduct; it is generally just verbal communication.

text: 特别需要强调的是，不要乱说什么大实话。
en: What must be especially emphasised is: do not blurt out blunt home truths.

text: 喜欢乱说大实话是招人恨的事情。
en: Liking to blurt out blunt home truths is the kind of thing that invites resentment.

text: 举个自己的例子，之前单位里有个利益中年妇女在单位里面各种勾搭领导，希望能做领导情人，大家都心照不宣地不说话，我不识趣地和另一个同事聊过，不出意外地话传到了那个当事人耳朵里，被人家记恨死。
en: To give an example from my own experience: there was a certain self-seeking middle-aged woman in my former work unit who kept trying to ingratiate herself with the leaders, hoping to become a leader's mistress; everyone tacitly kept quiet about it, but I, lacking tact, mentioned it to another colleague, and, unsurprisingly, the words reached the person involved, who bore a deadly grudge against me.

text: 所以当你无意间听到了看到了什么，最好当没有这个事情。
en: So when you happen to hear or see something, it is best to act as if it never happened.

text: 说大实话，有个你永远也想不到的潜台词意义，就是你潜意识里认为，你和对方是平等的，所以你可以说他几句。
en: Speaking blunt truths carries a subtextual meaning you could never imagine: it is that, subconsciously, you believe you are the equal of the other person, and therefore you feel entitled to criticise them a little.

text: 事实上，别人并不认为你和他是平等的。
en: In fact, others do not consider you their equal.

text: 举例，副总对经理说，你这个事情没做好。
en: For example, a deputy director says to a manager, 'You did not handle this matter well.'

text: 部门经理会虚心接受，因为副总有资格说这个话。
en: The department manager will accept it with an open mind, because the deputy director is entitled to say such a thing.

text: 但你不能随便说，因为你没有资格。
en: But you cannot say it casually, because you are not entitled to.

text: 你和部门经理不是平等的，人家是管理你的。
en: You and the department manager are not equals; he is the one who manages you.

text: 人和人的交往是个很复杂的事情，你说的每一句话，都会引发你想象不到的后果。
en: Interpersonal dealings are a very complicated matter; every word you say can trigger consequences you could never imagine.

text: 我年轻时候在这方面吃亏太多了。
en: I suffered too much in this regard when I was young.

text: 你说的话，人家转头就传出去了。
en: What you say, others will pass on the moment you turn your back.

text: 我一般给刚进单位的年轻人三个建议
en: I generally give three pieces of advice to young people who have just joined the work unit.

text: 一是尽可能不说话。
en: First, speak as little as possible.

text: 你不说话，至少不会冒犯别人，还能得个老实人的评价。
en: If you do not speak, at least you will not offend anyone, and you can even earn a reputation as an honest, straightforward person.

text: 二是尽可能说好话。
en: Second, praise others as much as possible.

text: 如果你实在忍不住要和同事聊天，最好开口就是赞美对方。
en: If you really cannot help but chat with colleagues, it is best to open with a compliment to the other person.

text: 三是大事化小。
en: Third, play things down.

text: 有些时候，你避不开，必须说几句，那你就大事化小，避重就轻，例如你心意是好的，就是方式方法不科学，好心办坏事。
en: Sometimes, when you cannot avoid speaking and must say a few words, then play things down and skirt the weighty points—for instance, say that your intentions were good but the method was unscientific, that you meant well but achieved the opposite.

text: 这样人家心里好受一点。
en: That way the other person feels a little better.

text: 78年的，44周岁，虽然生日还差俩月。
en: Born in '78, forty-four years old, though my birthday is still two months away.

text: 体会如下:
en: My reflections are as follows:

text: 1.心累，上有老下有小，中间有中年危机，体制外职场地位被年轻人窥视，只有不断的进取，和领导搞好关系才可以。
en: 1. Mentally exhausted: with ageing parents above and young children below, and a mid-life crisis in between; my standing in the workplace outside the system is coveted by young people, and I can only cope by constantly striving ahead and getting on well with my leaders.

text: 2.花钱的地方多了，随着孩子长大和父母的老去在身体和其他方面花费增加了，家庭支出也增多了。
en: 2. There are more places to spend money; as the children grow up and the parents age, spending on their health and other aspects has increased, and household expenditure has risen too.

text: 3.心理疾病有上升的态势，人到中年之后，很多人出现了焦虑情绪甚至抑郁，其实都是为了一个字:钱
en: 3. Mental illness is on the rise; after reaching middle age, many people develop anxiety and even depression—in truth it all comes down to one word: money.

text: 83年，自己感觉 人生的吃喝，人性的善恶，大都体验过了。
en: Born in '83; I feel I have largely experienced the eating and drinking of life, and the good and evil of human nature.

text: 也进过手术室，全麻，醒过来跟重生一样
en: I have also been in the operating theatre, under general anaesthetic, and waking up felt like being reborn.

text: 喜欢看历史书，资治通鉴从春秋看到开唐，会比较大部分皇帝 名人的寿数，汉朝大概还不能跟刘邦 刘彻比命长....
en: I enjoy reading history books; I read the Zizhi Tongjian from the Spring and Autumn period through to the founding of the Tang, and compare the lifespans of most emperors and famous figures—in the Han dynasty one probably still could not outlive Bang Liu or Che Liu....

text: 剩下的人生，最看重健康，有害健康的，就不做了。
en: For the rest of my life, what I value most is health; whatever is harmful to it, I simply will not do.

text: 80年42岁了，看见这个问题，想到前段时间实在情绪烦躁，在当地约了心理医生。
en: Born in '80 and now forty-two, seeing this question reminded me of a time not long ago when I was truly agitated, so I booked a psychologist locally.

text: 聊了不到两个小时吧，后面回到家发现她发了个朋友圈，类似于今天接诊一位中年女性…
en: We talked for less than two hours, and afterwards, back home, I found she had posted on Moments, something like 'Treated a middle-aged woman today…'

text: ，肯定不会说是哪位的，然后就记得 一地鸡毛 四个大字，在她眼里我的生活就是一地鸡毛吧
en: , she certainly would not say who it was, but I just remembered those four big characters, 'a floor strewn with chicken feathers'—in her eyes, my life must be just that: a complete mess.

text: 唉→_→感觉这个心理医生不够专业，还是需要舍近求远去外地了
en: *sigh* →_→ I feel this psychologist is not professional enough; I still need to go out of my way and travel to another city.

text: 今年有点难！
en: This year has been a bit hard!

text: 我们是上有生病，需要照顾的父母，下有上大学需要生活费的女儿，需要陪读的高一儿子，我们是顾得了老，顾不上小，一年四季忙得脚打后脑勺，年终一算，入不敷出。
en: We are, above, parents who are ill and need care; below, a daughter at university who needs living expenses, and a son in his first year of senior high who needs me to accompany him in his studies. We can attend to the elders but not the children; all year round we are rushed off our feet, and when we tally up at year's end, our outgoings exceed our income.

text: 父母都健康时，我在家种地，老公在外打工，一年能攒下不少，可今年初我妈大面积脑梗死，虽抢救回来，但生活无法自理，好在我还有两姐姐，
en: When both parents were healthy, I farmed at home while my husband worked away; we could save quite a bit in a year. But at the beginning of this year my mother suffered a massive cerebral infarction; although she was rescued, she cannot care for herself. Fortunately, I still have two elder sisters,

text: 我只需一月拿三百生活费既可，我妈安排好了，老公公又小脑萎缩，很严重，没办法老公只能回家照顾，九月，儿子考上高中，我只能来县里租房陪读，
en: I only need to give three hundred yuan a month for living expenses, and my mother is sorted; but my father-in-law also has cerebellar atrophy, which is very serious, so my husband had no choice but to return home to care for him. In September, our son was admitted to senior high, and I had to come to the county town to rent a place and accompany him in his studies,

text: 两个孩子的学费，生活费，老人的医药费，零零种种，一月六，七千，没了老公的收入，只能动用积蓄，可积蓄有限，我只能找份工作，
en: The two children's tuition, living expenses, and the elderly's medical fees—all sorts of bits and pieces—come to six or seven thousand a month. With my husband's income gone, I could only draw on our savings, but our savings were limited, so I had to find a job,

text: 可起早贪黑，儿子没人看着，学习直线下降，我是左右为难，愁得头发都白了，好在老公公病情稳定了，老公准备明年再外出打工，让我辞去工作，
en: But if I work from dawn to dusk, no one is watching our son, and his studies have plummeted; I was in a terrible dilemma, worried until my hair turned white. Fortunately my father-in-law's condition stabilised, and my husband plans to go and work away again next year, telling me to quit my job,

text: 安心陪儿子上学。
en: and peacefully accompany our son through school.

text: 2023年马上过去了，希望2024年父母身体健康，孩子努力学习，我们都心想事成1
en: 2023 is almost over; I hope that in 2024 our parents stay healthy, the children study hard, and we all achieve what we wish for1
Born in '85, forty-one years old.

text: 这个问题，我来答一下。
en: I will answer this question.

text: 上周带老父亲去西安复查腰椎。
en: Last week I took my elderly father to Xi'an to have his lumbar spine re-examined.

text: 他执意要带上3个孙子孙女，说让孩子们也见见世面。
en: He insisted on bringing the three grandchildren, saying he wanted the children to see the world a bit.

text: 检查结束，一行人去了秦岭动物园。
en: After the examination, our party went to the Qinling Zoo.

text: 孩子们雀跃着往前冲，我却在200元/时的自驾电瓶车租赁处，站了整整三分钟。
en: The children dashed forward cheering, while I stood for a full three minutes at the self-drive electric cart rental, which cost 200 yuan per hour.

text: 最后没舍得下单。
en: In the end I could not bring myself to place the order.

text: 攥着口袋里的钱，带着一家老小，开始了徒步。
en: Clutching the money in my pocket, I set off on foot with the whole family, old and young.

text: 那天西安降温，风特别冷。
en: That day Xi'an turned cold, and the wind was especially biting.

text: 父亲的腰撑不住了，拖着病腿一步一瘸跟在后面。
en: My father's back could take no more; dragging his ailing leg, he limped along behind, step by step.

text: 我牵着小女儿走出老远，回头还能看见他艰难挪移的身影。
en: I led my little daughter a long way ahead, and looking back I could still see his figure laboriously shuffling along.

text: 他反而安慰我：“能出来逛逛就好，走不动了歇会儿。
en: He instead comforted me: 'It is good enough to be out and about; if we cannot walk any more, we will rest a while.

text: 结果才逛了一半，父亲就彻底撑不住了。
en: As a result, we had only toured half of it when my father simply could no longer hold on.

text: 寒风里，他额头上渗满汗珠，对着孙女憨笑：“爷爷老了，不中用了！
en: In the cold wind, his forehead beaded with sweat, and he gave a silly grin to his granddaughter: 'Grandpa is old and useless now!

text: 当晚回酒店，看他坐在床边一个劲敲腿揉搓，我心里像打翻了五味瓶。
en: That night back at the hotel, watching him sit on the bed edge and keep rubbing and kneading his legs, my heart felt like a five-flavour bottle had been knocked over.

text: 我才41岁啊，怎么就把日子过成了这样？
en: I am only forty-one—how did I end up living life like this?

text: 一、40岁前，我把“安稳”当成了全部
en: I. Before turning forty, I took 'stability' to be everything.

text: 说实话，40岁以前，我一直觉得“安稳就是福”。
en: To be honest, before I turned forty, I always felt that 'stability is a blessing'.

text: 主业是村干部，闲时跑网约车。
en: My main job is as a village cadre, and in my spare time I drive for a ride-hailing app.

text: 每天扎进村里处理公务，忙完7小时，无缝衔接去跑车，再干4小时。
en: Every day I throw myself into the village to handle official duties; after seven busy hours, I seamlessly move on to drive, and work another four hours.

text: 累得倒头就睡，还傻傻觉得这就是“充实”。
en: So tired I just collapse into sleep, yet foolishly I thought this was 'fulfilment'.

text: 身边人都羡慕我：工作稳当，还能赚外快，老人健康，孩子懂事。
en: Everyone around me envied me: a stable job, extra income on the side, healthy elders, and sensible children.

text: 可只有自己知道，每天一睁眼就是固定轨迹。
en: Yet only I knew that every day I opened my eyes to the same fixed routine.

text: 像个陀螺被生活抽着转，看似忙，心里却空得发慌。
en: Like a spinning top whipped round by life, seemingly busy, yet inside hollow with panic.

text: 偶尔看到别人敢闯敢试，也曾心动。
en: Occasionally, seeing others dare to venture and try, I too felt a stir in my heart.

text: 但念头刚冒出来，就被自己按下去：“别折腾了，40了，上有老下有小，熬到孩子长大就好了。
en: But the thought had barely surfaced before I pushed it down: 'Stop churning things up; you are forty, with elders above and children below; just endure until the children grow up and it will be fine.

text: 现在才明白，什么叫“温水煮青蛙”。
en: Only now do I understand what 'boiling a frog in warm water' means.

text: 我就在这份看似稳妥的安逸里，一点一点，磨掉了所有棱角和冲劲。
en: It was in this seemingly secure ease that, bit by bit, I wore away all my edges and drive.

text: 二、41岁的觉醒，是从父亲递来的500块钱开始的
en: II. The awakening at forty-one began with the 500 yuan my father handed me.

text: 从西安返回甘肃的路上，父亲在副驾驶睡着了。
en: On the road from Xi'an back to Gansu, my father fell asleep in the passenger seat.

text: 鼾声里偶尔夹杂一声“哎呦”——是白天累狠了。
en: Amid his snores came the occasional 'ow'—he had been worn out during the day.

text: 三个孩子瘫在后座，小脸上还带着游玩后的红晕。
en: The three children sprawled on the back seat, their little faces still flushed from the outing.

text: 我握着方向盘，一个念头在脑子里炸开：41岁不是终点，我的人生，才刚刚开始。
en: Gripping the steering wheel, a thought exploded in my mind: forty-one is not the end; my life has only just begun.

text: 回想毕业后的20年，我干过9个行业。
en: Looking back over the 20 years since graduation, I have worked in 9 industries.

text: 早些年做汽车销售、保险，也曾是别人眼中的“销售精英”，月入过万。
en: In earlier years I did car sales and insurance, and was once seen by others as a 'sales elite', earning over ten thousand a month.

text: 可如今，我却缩在“安稳”这个壳里，连探头的勇气都没了。
en: Yet now, I have shrunk into the shell of 'stability', without even the courage to poke my head out.

text: 大女儿今年初三。
en: My eldest daughter is in her third year of junior high this year.

text: 每次说教，最后都变成诉苦：“你知道我多忙？
en: Every time I lecture her, it ends up becoming a complaint: 'Do you know how busy I am?

text: 你花的钱，我要拼多少力气才能挣来？
en: The money you spend—how much effort must I exert to earn it?

text: 说得多了，女儿越来越小心翼翼。
en: The more I said it, the more cautious and timid my daughter became.

text: 她说现在买东西都要反复衡量，生怕一不小心就被我责怪。
en: She said that now when buying things she weighs it over and over, afraid that the slightest misstep will bring my reproach.

text: 那一刻我才惊觉，我的窘迫，正在悄悄消耗掉孩子的底气。
en: It was at that moment I realised with a start that my embarrassment was quietly draining my child's sense of security.

text: 父母已经年过六旬。
en: My parents are already past sixty.

text: 小时候总对他们喊：“等我长大了，挣好多钱，带你们去好多地方！
en: When I was little I would always shout at them: 'When I grow up I will earn lots of money and take you to many places!

text: 可如今，一个200块钱的电瓶车，就把我这个“孝顺儿子”的体面，撕得粉碎。
en: Yet now, a 200-yuan electric cart has torn to shreds the dignity of me, this 'filial son'.

text: 车到彬县服务区充电时，父亲默默走过来，掏出500块钱塞到我手里：“拿着，我知道你也不容易。
en: When the car reached the Binxian service area to charge, my father silently came over, took out 500 yuan and pressed it into my hand: 'Take it; I know you are having a hard time too.

text: 两个孩子花销大，我和你妈还能奔忙几年，这次看病耽误你挣钱了。
en: The two children cost a lot; your mother and I can still work away for a few years; this time, my seeing the doctor has delayed your earning.

text: 接过钱的瞬间，我差点在服务区泪崩。
en: The moment I took the money, I nearly broke down in tears at the service area.

text: 小时候他们怕我长不大；如今我都41岁了，他们还在为我的生计操心。
en: When I was little they feared I would not grow up; now that I am forty-one, they are still worrying about my livelihood.

text: 我这个当儿子的，连让他们舒舒服服玩一天的底气，都没有。
en: As their son, I do not even have the wherewithal to let them enjoy a comfortable day out.

text: 在服务区洗手间，我对镜子里那个满脸疲惫的中年人说：必须改变。
en: In the service area restroom, I said to the weary middle-aged man in the mirror: change must happen.

text: 从那天起，每晚不出车的那两小时，我不再刷手机虚度。
en: From that day on, during the two hours each night when I was not driving, I no longer wasted time scrolling my phone.

text: 坐下来读书，写作，把经历、感悟、踩过的坑，都写下来。
en: I sit down to read and write, and set down my experiences, realisations, and the pitfalls I have stumbled into.

text: 哪怕写得不好，哪怕被嘲笑。
en: Even if what I write is poor, even if I am ridiculed.

text: 也不想再做回那个连尝试都不敢的懦夫。
en: I also do not want to go back to being that coward who dared not even try.

text: 人就活一次，总得为自己大胆活一回。
en: One only lives once; one must live boldly for oneself at least once.

text: 三、写给同龄的你
en: III. To You of the Same Age

text: 人到中年，肩上扛着责任，心里依然可以藏着热爱。
en: Having reached middle age, with responsibility on one's shoulders, one can still harbour passion in one's heart.

text: 别让“年纪大了”“折腾不起”这种话，困住自己。
en: Do not let phrases like 'I am too old' and 'cannot afford to churn things up' trap yourself.

text: 这辈子很短，别将就。
en: This life is short; do not settle.

text: 你想要的日子，只要你愿意开始，永远都不晚。
en: The life you want—as long as you are willing to begin—is never too late.

text: 41岁不是天花板，是下半场的开场哨。
en: Forty-one is not a ceiling; it is the opening whistle of the second half.

text: 85年的我，41岁才醒过来，动起来。
en: I, born in '85, only woke up and started moving at forty-one.

text: 你呢？
en: And you?

text: 今年多大？
en: How old this year?

text: 有没有那么一个瞬间，让你也想换一种活法？
en: Was there a moment that made you want to live differently too?

text: 欢迎在评论区聊聊。
en: Feel free to chat in the comments section.

text: 咱们一起，给彼此加个油。
en: Let us cheer each other on.

text: 最后，关于我：
en: Finally, about me:

text: 我是建涛，85年，甘肃人。
en: I am Tao Jian, born in '85, from Gansu.

text: 20年横跨9种职业，目前主业村官，副业滴滴+写作如果你也是想改变的中年人，可以关注粽子号【建涛手记】。
en: Having spanned 9 careers over 20 years, my current main job is village official and my side jobs are Didi and writing. If you are also a middle-aged person wanting change, you can follow the Zongzi account [Tao Jian's Notes].

text: 咱们一起，把日子过得热气腾腾。
en: Together, let us make our days full of warmth and bustle.
